payload.title: Hollin Mere pilot plan
payload.text:
# Goal

Run Tidewater at the Port of Hollin Mere for six weeks and compare its berth plans with the ones the harbour office makes by hand.

# Scope

- The main quay, berths Q1 to Q6.
- Tide tables from the harbour office's tide software.

# Timeline

The pilot starts after the Tidewater 1.8 release. In week one Tidewater plans next to the harbour office; from week two the harbour office works from Tidewater's plan and corrects it where needed.

# Rollback

If a plan is wrong twice in one week, the harbour office goes back to planning by hand and we look for the cause together.

payload.title: Формат пакета телеметрии Beacon v2.3
payload.text:
# Формат пакета

Начиная с v2.3 пакет телеметрии — это JSON, сжатый gzip. Несжатый пакет занимает около 412 байт, сжатый — около 190.

# Заголовок кадра

Первый байт заголовка — версия формата (2), второй — кодировка: 0 — JSON без сжатия, 1 — JSON со сжатием gzip. Приёмники Fogbell RX-40 читают кодировку 1 начиная с прошивки 4.2.

# История

- 8 сентября решили перейти на CBOR.
- 23 сентября от CBOR отказались: приёмники RX-40 читают только JSON.

payload.title: Release checklist
payload.text:
# Before the release

- The full regression passes on the release candidate.
- The release date is not a harbour inspection day: check the harbour calendar.
- The harbour office knows the date a week ahead.

# On the day

1. Tag the release on main.
2. Deploy to the harbour's staging system, then to production.
3. Post in #general.

# After

Watch the berth plans of the next two days for anything unusual.
